description: Human-visible RedCap status updates and Feishu notifications must expose the same compact state surface instead of leaking noisy internal audit logs.
status_update_rule: Terminal interruptions and checkpoints must expose the full required_status_fields surface. Feishu node-report messages should expose the compact required_feishu_fields surface so they stay readable on mobile and do not duplicate route fields.
narrative_quality_rule: Human-facing reports must be paragraph-readable and conclusion-first. Prefer explaining the problem being solved, the chosen solution, the resulting effect, the next step, and whether human help is needed; do not make the primary explanation a changelog of files, scripts, moves, or command outputs.
report_led_summary_rule: When a task report exists, interruption/final updates must summarize report sections 0.1-0.4 first, include 0.5 human-intervention status when available, then surface any non-empty 人工审核要点 or 人工验证项 before technical file/script details.
feishu_alignment_rule: Feishu node-report and manual-intervention messages must use the compact required_feishu_fields surface, not the full terminal status field list. Layer B final node-report is a closeout-runtime responsibility after receipt generation; on-complete and session-end must not also send a duplicate success node-report inside that path.
feishu_deduplication_rule: Feishu node-report must not repeat task route content as separate 任务全景图 / 当前位置 / 整体计划脉络图 sections. Merge route and current-node context into a single 任务位置 section, and keep commit details under compact 关键证据 instead of a long 提交清单.
internal_audit_gap_rule: SessionEnd / Stop audit gaps are internal control-plane signals by default. They must be recorded to pending closure / ledger / diagnostics, but must not send Feishu unless the gap is a true manual-intervention blocker.
